remarks: Beautiful and spacious two bedroom-two full bath ranch-style unit in the highly sought-after Stonewood complex. The complex was totally rebuilt from the ground up in 2019! This stunning unit features just under 1200n sqft of living space, high ceilings, open floor plan, primary bedroom suite with w/w carpet, full bath & walk-in closet. The living room/dining area has a French door leading to private deck, and a remodeled kitchen with breakfast bar, granite counters, stainless steel appliances and tiled flooring. There is a second bedroom, full bath and in-unit laundry. The Stonewood complex offers garage parking, gym, exterior security cameras and lobby area. Conveniently located on the Darien line just minutes away from the train station, highways, shopping & restaurants. Subject to Probate Court Approval & possible appeal period.
